name: CartDrawer
summary: Commerce-flavor Drawer pre-composed as the side cart. Renders a CartLineItem list (image + title + variant + qty stepper + price + remove), a totals subgroup (subtotal / discount / shipping / total), and a sticky-footer Checkout CTA. Distinct from MiniCart (small popover preview) — CartDrawer is a full side panel.

items.description: Array of { id, image, title, variant?, qty, price, lineTotal }.

freeShippingProgress.description: 0-100. Renders a Progress bar 'Add $X to unlock free shipping' inside the header.

promoSlot.description: Render-prop slot for a CouponInput / loyalty banner.

keyboard: ArrowUp / ArrowDown on qty stepper - increment / decrement
Delete / Backspace on focused line item - remove with confirmation
rules: Drawer behavior: role='dialog', aria-modal='true', aria-labelledby={titleId}, focus trap, Escape closes.
Each CartLineItem is a <li> with aria-label='{title}, qty {qty}, {lineTotal}'.
Quantity stepper announces 'Quantity {N}' via aria-live='polite' on change.
Removing an item announces 'Removed {title}' via aria-live; pair with an Undo Snackbar.
Totals: each line is a labeled key-value pair (<dl> + <dt> / <dd>).

do: Pin the Checkout CTA in a sticky footer.
Surface free-shipping progress prominently when within 25% of the threshold.
Use action.danger-soft tone on Remove buttons (not solid danger).
Pair Remove with an Undo Snackbar so accidental removes are recoverable.
dont: Don't auto-scroll on every qty change.
Don't render the cart as a Dialog (centered modal) — that breaks the spatial 'cart sits to the side' mental model.
Don't paint the cart total in solid lime fill — accent tint surface only.
Don't put marketing offers above the cart line items — the user opened the cart to see their cart.
